items.summary_en: American Geographical Society Library, University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee Libraries The royal tombs in Abydos were constructed 500 years before the Giza pyramids. In Umm el-Qaab, a royal funerary complex in Abydos, ancient Egypt’s first pharaohs were laid to rest some 5,000 years ago — alongside dozens of their subjects. items.title_en: A Scientific Institution Called For New Inventions — So Benjamin Franklin Wrote A Letter Advocating For A Solution To Smelly Farts
items.title_zh: 科学机构呼吁新发明——本杰明·富兰克林因此写了一封信，倡导解决臭屁问题
items.summary_en: Philadelphia Museum of Art A politician, inventor, and philosopher, Benjamin Franklin wrote the “Fart Proudly” essay as a satirical piece discussing the problem of flatulence. Benjamin Franklin is known for many things. He was an inventor, a publisher, a philosopher, and one of the Founding Fathers. He was also the author of an essay known today as “Fart Proudly.” The essay, which Franklin wrote as a joke in 1781, discussed the common problem of flatulence — and its odor.
items.summary_zh: 费城艺术博物馆 本杰明·富兰克林是一位政治家、发明家和哲学家，他撰写了《骄傲地放屁》这篇文章，作为一篇讨论胀气问题的讽刺文章。本杰明·富兰克林因许多事情而闻名。他是一位发明家、出版商、哲学家和开国元勋之一。他还是一篇今天被称为“自豪地放屁”的文章的作者。这篇文章是富兰克林在 1781 年写的，作为一个笑话，讨论了肠胃气胀的常见问题及其气味。
